props.stem: A short situation in one or two sentences sets the scene. What is the best thing to do?

options.text: The first option, a plausible action of similar length
options.feedback: Not quite: say in one sentence why this option falls short.

options.text: The second option, the right action in this situation
options.feedback: Right: say in one sentence why this is the best choice here.

options.text: The third option, another plausible but weaker action
options.feedback: Not quite: say what this option misses, and what it risks.
